recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add or otherwise change ProvenanceActivityType for FHIR-19410; any future richer activity vocabulary should come through a new Security WG decision.
issue_request: FHIR-19410 was Published with resolution Persuasive. It objected that v3 ParticipationType codes such as transcriber describe roles/functions, not actions, and the accepted resolution said the Provenance activity type value set should not include v3 participation types while leaving future activity vocabulary work open.
initial_application: Git commit d417c5d674f23099e6f3e481c34e0100c7aa5a66 applied GF#19410 by commenting out the v3-ParticipationType include in the then-current source/provenance/valueset-provenance-activity-type.xml. Subsequent source history moved the value set into source/terminologies and continued to leave v3 ParticipationType out.
additional_context: A 2020 Zulip comment from Lloyd McKenzie noted that the initial fix only removed participation codes and still left other inappropriate state/status vocabularies. Later same-artifact issues changed the current interpretation: FHIR-23712 temporarily broadened the value set, FHIR-32517 later superseded that broad model by making Provenance.activity example-bound and reducing the value set to representative ISO 21089 lifecycle examples, and FHIR-55797/FHIR-55798 refined that current ISO example value set. FHIR-22104, FHIR-23712, and FHIR-32517 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini lists Provenance as an active resource, source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml binds Provenance.activity with strength example to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/provenance-activity-type, and source/terminologies/valueset-provenance-activity-type.xml contains only selected ISO 21089 lifecycle activity codes. The active sources do not include v3 ParticipationType or the historical broad state/status includes.
